        self._dp_size = getattr(sa, "dp_size", 1) or 1

        if not self._spec_active:

                    + ceil_align(self._speculative_eagle_topk, page_size),
                    page_size,

                ceil_align(max_draft, page_size),

            self._speculative_num_steps * self._speculative_eagle_topk,
